rules.rule: No API route may return secret key material: Stellar secret keys, seeds, mnemonics, private keys, or a decrypted org secret. decryptOrgSecret may only be used to sign server-side; src/lib/security/no-secret-routes.test.ts must keep passing and its allowlist must not grow without a stated reason.

On mainnet (STELLAR_NETWORK=public) no secret material, encrypted or not, may be written to the database. Any new write path for stellar_disbursement_secret_encrypted or recovery_encrypted_secret must go through the secretPersistenceAllowed() guard in src/lib/security/mainnet-secrets.ts.

Every code path that builds or submits a USDC payout (contract payout, SAC transfer, classic payment, batch or distribution run) must call enforcePayoutCaps from src/lib/payouts/caps.ts with all amounts in the run, and must fail closed when caps are missing on mainnet. Amounts are compared as bigint stroops, never as floats.

API routes take the caller's identity and org only from the server session (getSession / getUserBySessionId). Never trust a user id, org id, role or wallet address taken from the request body, query string or headers for authorization.

Soroban contracts: one-time initialization guarded by the constructor-set admin's require_auth, every privileged entry point calls require_auth, amounts are validated (positive, within caps), overflow-checks stays enabled in the release profile, and every behavior change ships with a Rust test including the failure case.
Do not log secret keys, unlock cookies, session values, passkey credentials, or full user/org identifiers in new console.log calls.
